'''2016 MPC Trevor Partridge LS Combat Preparedness (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Trevor Partridge]] at [[2016 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Trevor Partridge]]
* '''Event:''' [[2016 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Naboo|Cor-L-naboo.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2016-match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163128/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2016-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
